status: secondary validation protocol fixed after schema/category inspection but before reading numerical result values
prior_information: OrderSage paper aggregate conclusions and file schemas/commands/order counts are known. This is not external preregistration, an unseen corpus claim or a new acquisition. No numerical CSV result values have been printed or summarized by the editor before this protocol.
input: All three published case studies at ordersage/paper-artifact commit aed526a5a86432834b881bf0166a34f6ffe57623, six exact Git-blob-verified CSVs bound by external-ordersage-inputs/MANIFEST.json. No case or benchmark is selected on a numerical outcome. Raw files remain local; redistribution license has not been located.
units_and_scope: All three corpora can assess a shared log-position envelope within each benchmark after removing its own fitted center. Commands performing different work are never ranked. Only ufs versus ext4nj with the SAME workload suffix are ranking alternatives, exactly as the published paper describes. Their result is throughput, so cost is minus log(result). This is an external systems-method stress assessment, not Hopper calibration or same-state ground truth.
validation_integrity: Every row must have successful status, finite positive scalar result, consistent run metadata and exactly one occurrence of every command per episode with a complete position permutation. Fail closed on malformed input instead of dropping rows. Group whole episodes by run_uuid, hostname, run_num and order_type; sort each order type by integer run_num then time_start/UUID. Within EACH type use first half of episodes for calibration and remaining half for assessment. No measurement from an assessment episode changes a budget or fit.
calibration: For each command take the arithmetic mean of log(result) across RANDOM calibration episodes as its frozen center theta_hat. For every random calibration episode, in position order form z_j=log(result_j)-theta_hat(command_j); subtracting z_0 fixes a harmless per-run offset. Set delta_cal to the largest absolute adjacent difference |z_j-z_(j-1)| over ALL random calibration episodes. Gamma=0; all measured calibration residual/noise/carryover is absorbed in this effective adjacent budget. Delta is an empirical maximum, not a causal physical drift estimate, confidence bound or certified future bound. No multiplier is tuned.
heldout_envelope_check: Separately for ALL heldout fixed and random episodes calculate the maximum adjacent difference relative to the frozen calibration centers. Report whole-episode coverage at delta_cal, maximum required delta and ratio to delta_cal, plus total adjacent-constraint violations. Also repeat this descriptive coverage check using the center derived solely from heldout random means, clearly labelled an assessment reference and never used to tune delta. This second check is descriptive, not an independent estimate of latent true costs. Report every failure.
ranking_assessment: In uFS retain all ten matched workload pairs and ALL heldout fixed episodes. Use their one-observation point log-cost vector as the query. Compare naive zero-budget gap, shared-path delta_cal, floor-position-zero independent box delta_cal, and a box reanchored at each candidate; the last has the SAME pair supports as the path and is a required strong comparator, not a claimed novelty gain. A unique certificate needs its rival support strictly negative. A heldout random reference is separated only if the observed cost range of one filesystem over ALL heldout random episodes lies strictly below the other's range. Otherwise mark reference ambiguous, never assign a true winner. Cross-tab unique agreeing, unique contradicting, ambiguous-reference unique, and abstaining. This finite observed reference is not a confidence interval, counterfactual truth or application benefit. There are ten tasks, repeated episodes are dependent observations, not independent workload samples.
additional_diagnostics: Report fixed-order gaps versus heldout randomized mean gaps for matched uFS pairs, reference ranges, observation/episode denominators, minimum and maximum observed positions, and all calibration/assessment sizes. The full mathematical anchoring comparison must be corrected independently of whether the external numbers are favorable. Do not re-run the split/budget after outcomes to improve counts.
comparison_boundary: No known-truth misspecification-detection, prospective deployment, hardware ranking correctness, GPU bias budget, distribution-free coverage, exchangeability or statistical significance claim is supported by this split alone. Failures may arise from arm-specific state, temporal change, fitting error or noise and do not identify a causal mechanism. All negative findings stay in the report. These published data cannot replace counterbalanced native Hopper acquisition.
